Actual Article Body:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

A bozo wearing clown makeup allegedly threatened on social media to shoot President Trump at a Florida campaign rally on Friday.

Allison Albro, 21, of Daytona Beach, was arrested after she posted on Thursday that she was going to a Trump rally with her “Glock” to shoot the president, Volusia County Sheriff Mike Chitwood said in a statement.

“Going to the Trump rally in my city tmr so I can shoot him with my glock! Wish me luck, guys!” Albro wrote, posing for a selfie with clown makeup.

Trump is holding a midterm campaign rally on Friday for Republican candidates, including Rep. Bryon Donalds, Sen. Ashley Moody and Rep. Randy Fine, at the Ocean Center in Daytona Beach.

The sheriff’s department’s Domestic Security Unit and the Secret Service visited Albro, who allegedly told investigators the post was a joke and that she didn’t have access to a Glock or any other weapons, Chitwood said.

She was booked on charges of making written threats to kill and unlawful use of a communications device, the sheriff added.

In a mugshot released by cops, Albro frowned with the makeup smeared around her eyes and face.

She is being held behind bars without bond, WESH reported.
